title: Count Up
description:
# Count Up

This program is **supposed to** read an integer `n` and print the integers from `1` to `n`, one per line.

But it doesn't work. Fix it so the tests pass.

## Input

A single integer `n` (`1 ≤ n ≤ 1000`).

## Output

The numbers `1` through `n`, each on its own line.

```
Input:
3

Output:
1
2
3
```
